Title: Does Deviki get around can not play Discipline cards on vampires with superior?

Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
Does Deviki get around can not play Discipline cards on vampires with superior?

Deviki Prasanta
Unique ghoul with 2 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed.If Deviki is ready during your master phase, you can lock Deviki to search your library (shuffle afterward) and/or ash heap for a master discipline card and put it on a ready Assamite you control.

Quietus
Put this card on a vampire. This vampire gets +1 level of Quietus and +1 capacity. Cannot be put on a vampire with superior Quietus .

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> XZealot wrote:
> Does Deviki get around can not play Discipline cards on vampires with superior?
>
> Deviki Prasanta
> Unique ghoul with 2 life. 1 strength, 0 bleed.If Deviki is ready during your master phase, you can lock Deviki to search your library (shuffle afterward) and/or ash heap for a master discipline card and put it on a ready Assamite you control.
>
> Quietus
> Put this card on a vampire. This vampire gets +1 level of Quietus and +1 capacity. Cannot be put on a vampire with superior Quietus .
>
No. The card cannot be put on a vampire with the superior Discipline, so Deviki cannot "put it" on such vampires.
